name: app-bottom-navigation-dark-and-light-variants-on-lilac-with-gradient-title
title: Bottom Navigation Dark and Light Mode Set
whatItIs: A lilac board titled with a blue to orange gradient 'Bottom Navigation Dark & Light Mode' showing five bar styles in black on the left and white on the right (curved notch with a plus button, diamond centre button, circular centre button, pill highlight, underline indicator) beside an icon sheet with outline and filled variants.
whatItMeans: Pairing dark and light versions and showing outline versus filled icons documents both themes and states at once.
techniques: Five nav layouts in two themes
Outline and filled icon pairs for inactive and active
Notch and diamond centre buttons as variety

vocabulary.definition: A bar with a curved cut-out to cradle a centre button.
An icon in two styles for active and inactive.
A short line beneath the selected tab.
